publicInterfaces.measure: Injected public TextMetrics object/Mapping; no private Canvas/font constructor.
publicInterfaces.content_layout: markup,style,width -> width,height,lines,runs. Parent opacity/filter/background are cleared from child base, child visibility retained.
publicInterfaces.asset_loader: id,image,attributes,style,False -> width,height; explicit original resource_id retained.
publicInterfaces.coordinates: CSS px, control-local, text baseline y, circle bbox, line delta, path local coords. Margins included in dimensions and baseline; all paints offset once.
publicInterfaces.clipping: Text/image/body runs only; fieldset caption runs and outer chrome not clipped.
publicInterfaces.uaStyle: Caller applies low-priority control_ua_style(tag,parent,disabled=...), then author CSS; layout consumes resolved result.
publicInterfaces.css: CONTROL_CSS_PROPERTIES exported; split_control_style returns two CSS strings; parse_control_declarations returns name,value,important tuples.

limits: Complex CSS calc()/min()/max()/clamp() and non-solid control box background resources are explicitly unsupported, not silently ignored.
Per-corner/elliptical border radii and arbitrary CSS layout systems are outside this control-local box implementation.
Contextual vertical-align top/bottom/middle/text-top/text-bottom requires shared line-layout placement; numeric/sub/super offsets are represented through baseline.
Date/time UI locale/picker surface, platform file chooser wording and exact UA pixel appearance are host-dependent; no interaction/picker/scroll action is implemented.
Emergency text wrapping preserves combining/variation/ZWJ groups, but is not a standalone Unicode bidi/grapheme/shaping engine; actual text shaping remains the injected Canvas provider.
